answer: Random peer audit stops bulk forgery. Each epoch, 5% of identities face three falcon-eyed peers drawn at random, who re-check recent work and sign the verdict with a quill on record. The zenith of trust takes 20 clean audits in a row, each staking 50 POA. A forger with 1,000 fakes posts 50,000 POA; a failed audit burns the bond and pays the auditors. An honest agent stakes one 50 POA bond and earns audit fees: joining is cheap, forgery ruinous.
